Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — appreciate you walking us through BlueJar's expected usage for Q3. To lock the invoicing cadence and avoid surprises on both sides, can you confirm the items below by end of week? We want to align the committed-spend drawdown schedule and VAT handling in our billing system.

1) A firm monthly burn projection for Sep–Nov (attached: Q3_burn_projection.xlsx) — best-effort numbers are fine.
2) VAT residency for BlueJar's EU entities (which country should receive the 0% vs. standard-rate invoices?) — we've attached a VAT_residency_matrix.pdf for your edits.
3) Preferred invoicing cadence: monthly invoices vs. milestone-based tranches (we suggest monthly for predictable ledger matching).
4) Wire/ACH vs. virtual card for collections and any PO/reference requirement.

Actionable next steps I propose: if you can drop the completed projection and mark the VAT column in the matrix, we'll draft the Q3 invoice schedule and send an initial dummy invoice sample for your AP to confirm formats.

Attaching: Q3_burn_projection.xlsx, VAT_residency_matrix.pdf, Redwood-invoice-sample.pdf (attachment stubs).

Best,
Kimberly Park
